name: Prayer to Elune
summary: In Searing Gorge, Zamael Lunthistle waits in a cage and asks for your help. Many years have passed since anyone visited him, and first he asks you to hear his tale.

sections.title: A Spirit in a Cage
sections.body: Zamael Lunthistle greets you with praise to Elune. Many years have passed since anyone came to visit him. Now he asks for your help. First, hear his tale.

sections.title: Zamael's Tale
sections.body:
As a young night elf from Darkshore, Zamael fell under the Twilight's Hammer's influence and turned from Elune. Then a vision from Elune woke him from his malaise as a follower of the old gods. In repentance, he carved his sorrow into a tablet of pure gold as a prayer to Elune.

The Twilight's Hammer found the tablet and branded him a blasphemer. They had him executed before his prayer was finished. Now Zamael's spirit is bound to the world and held in a cage as a warning to those who would betray the Twilight's Hammer's faith. He has accepted his fate, but the prayer must still be found.

aliases: who is the ghost in the cage
faq.answer: Zamael Lunthistle is a spirit held in a cage in Searing Gorge. He asks you to hear his tale.

faq.q: What does Zamael ask of you?
faq.answer: Zamael asks for your help. First, he asks you to hear his tale.

faq.q: What comes after hearing Zamael's tale?
faq.answer: After hearing Zamael's tale, you can hear its second part from him.
